name: wander
description: WANDER — a no-code, browser-based 3D world creation engine (Rust/WASM core, React editor, three.js renderer).

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path crates/wander-core/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.prepare:engine: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:runtime
scripts.build: npm run prepare:engine && tsc --noEmit && vite build
